antonioo_sg: Nils Antonioo arrived on Day 8 as a replacement. The men in R-S4 had been fighting for 8 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Nils Antonioo spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A letter from home found Nils Antonioo before the night shift. Nils Antonioo folded it small and kept it close.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Nils Antonioo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Nils Antonioo was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S4. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Clement Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424). Nils Antonioo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 527. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is lost. Nils Antonioo heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

The medic looked at Nils Antonioo's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-S4. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. A letter from home found Nils Antonioo before the night shift. Nils Antonioo folded it small and kept it close.
A replacement turned out to be from Northwick too. Nils Antonioo and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
Roland Monster of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at Saint-Ash crossroads. Nils Antonioo of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.
Matthias "Bones" Dawg kept watch so that Nils Antonioo could sleep. Then Nils kept watch so that Bones could. Neither slept.
After the flight, Nils Antonioo found a sweetheart card tucked behind the compass: 'Seaside' (common). The mechanic swore he never saw it.
Nils Antonioo made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.
Nils passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
baronthelietch: Bastian Barontheliet unpacked his mother's thimble at R-R16. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Bastian Barontheliet let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Bastian Barontheliet held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. Grey Mill has been won. Bastian Barontheliet listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Tobias Polley of the Concord spotted Bastian Barontheliet of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Hill 304. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Asked what he will do after the war, Bastian Barontheliet said: 'Be a postman in Northwick. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
In reserve, Bastian Barontheliet slept nine hours in a barn. He dreamt of nothing, which was the best part.

Bastian Barontheliet was hit in the hip at R-R16. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Marek "Owl" Schu of the Concord (@zde_schu). Bastian Barontheliet looked over the parapet at R-R16 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Marek "Owl" Schu of the Concord (@zde_schu).
The papers connected Matthias Barontheliet to Bastian Barontheliet. The men took longer to learn Matthias Barontheliet's own habits, but they made the effort.

Matthias Barontheliet threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Arno Coopergfulto was down and screaming for a medic. (@coopergfulton) The Concord sentry, Arno "Smokes" Den, shouted once. Matthias Barontheliet silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@ay.den0707) Matthias Barontheliet joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Back from the raid, Matthias Barontheliet found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'My Pal' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. A bullet found Matthias Barontheliet at R-R16, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Otto Dmcm of the Concord (@dmcm18_22). Matthias Barontheliet stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-R16. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Otto Dmcm of the Concord (@dmcm18_22).
Tobias "Rabbit" Barontheliet put his mother's thimble beside the bunk. Someone who had known Matthias Barontheliet helped clear the shelf without saying why.

A round came through the loophole Tobias "Rabbit" Barontheliet was watching at R-R16 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Benedikt Ghostrider of the Concord (@ghostrider_q3f). No bed for Tobias "Rabbit" Barontheliet. A medic cut his sleeve away, bandaged the wound, and moved on to the next stretcher.
There was never a bed for Tobias, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-R16 on his own feet.
chiaroveto: Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto arrived at Q-F18 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. Victory at Grey Mill. Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto was absent when the patrol returned from Lantern Hill. The corporal checked the list against the faces, then checked it again.
Found with a party from another section, Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto was guided back to Q-F18. The relief on the corporal's face lasted until the lecture began.

A bullet hit Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto's belt buckle at Q-F18 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Florian "Mole" Stinkyzebrab of the Concord (@stinkyzebraballs).
Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at Q-F18 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto aimed a step ahead and fired: Nils Costava, badly wounded. A bullet clipped Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto's helmet at Q-F18 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Isidor Mtzrn of the Concord (@david_mtzrn).
Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Bastian "Tin" Nvd and Norbert "Doc" Chiaroveto divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
civo_mat: Walter Mat came up the line in the rain with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
One of the first hundred, Walter Mat was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Walter Mat caught a falling mug with his foot. Saving the mug was impressive; retrieving the foot without spilling it required assistance.
The transfer made Walter Mat a sapper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Walter Mat approved the method. The sergeant read out the order: Verdel Ridge has fallen, hold the line. Walter Mat looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The parcel for Walter Mat contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
Walter Mat saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Mat crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at S-F13 holds again. Machine-gun fire swept S-F13. Walter Mat took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Clement Tsanev of the Concord (@vl.tsanev). Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Walter Mat watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The beds were full. Walter Mat waits on a stretcher in the dark with a medic's promise and a dry mouth.
The medics would not give up on Walter Mat. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-F13 today.

Walter Mat drew a map of Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki's hometown from Owl's stories. Owl says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Mat checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Mat counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Lucien Raphoto never saw the shovel coming. (@r.raphoto) In the dark of the Concord trench Walter Mat hit Nils Mrpickypants with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@mrpickypants_) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Walter Mat snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Walter Mat free. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Walter Mat could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

The medic cut the last bandage off Walter Mat's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F13 the same hour. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill has been won. Walter Mat listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Walter Mat and Silas Menezes made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Nils Axebozo reads Walter Mat's letters from home out loud, because Walter never learned to read. Nils leaves out the sad parts. Walter knows. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Walter Mat tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F13 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Mat found an old map of Saint-Ash crossroads from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Mat. Walter Mat read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Walter Mat reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

The Concord sentry, Benedikt Noirangelfan, shouted once. Walter Mat silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@noirangelfang) Walter Mat crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Quentin Rocco reached for a rifle. Walter Mat was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@ben._.rocco) A letter reached Walter Mat in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.

Walter Mat drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. Walter Mat kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

Walter offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. The mail bag had a letter for Walter and nothing for anyone else. Walter read it as quietly as he could.
eventhatoneguywastaken: Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-C8 changed before the cheering ended. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg shouldered another load.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg aimed a step ahead and fired: Karel Zzkaake, grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg is number 668. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill has been won. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Wendel Realshayanwo and Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg and Wendel Realshayanwo compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Jonas "Button" Eventhatoneg lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Jonas changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
furry_raptor3945: Dorian "Lucky" Raptor found a place in Q-S6 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S6. Dorian "Lucky" Raptor has learned to walk bent double.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Dorian "Lucky" Raptor in the open at Q-S6. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble). Dorian "Lucky" Raptor stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-S6. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Bastian "Parson" Wamble of the Hegemony (@josh.wamble).

Another member of the House of Raptor reached the line: Edmund Raptor. He asked where Dorian "Lucky" Raptor had slept, then chose a different corner. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Edmund Raptor read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Edmund Raptor was carrying water up to Q-S6 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Edmund Raptor did not. Shot by Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa of the Hegemony (@bannerlordsarp).
Edmund Raptor spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to Q-S6.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Casimir Nshill, grazed. Edmund Raptor cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Edmund Raptor put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Edmund Raptor stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.

Edmund Raptor was hit through the chest at Q-S6. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Arno "Brick" Android of the Hegemony (@emotionless_android). Edmund Raptor looked over the parapet at Q-S6 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Arno "Brick" Android of the Hegemony (@emotionless_android).
A letter came with Cyril Raptor: "I am Edmund Raptor's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
The gun crews at Q-S6 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Leopold Paz was grazed.
gagulaa__: Clement Gagulaa reached V-F11 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Clement Gagulaa stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Felix "Parson" Matt and Clement Gagulaa share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Clement Gagulaa's ear at V-F11 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Gideon "Spark" Jaxk of the Hegemony (@mr_jaxk1).
Back on the fire step at V-F11. Clement Gagulaa says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.
Clement Gagulaa saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
Clement Gagulaa owes Viktor Bandit so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
A report called the trench satisfactory. Clement Gagulaa invited the author to spend a night in it before signing.
A parcel came for Clement that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.
goated.josh: The new rifleman is Pavel Josh, once a postman from Rosenau. The corporal asked if a postman was any use in a trench. Pavel Josh said he would find out.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-C1 with the rations. Pavel Josh ate while listening to the revised orders.

Pavel Josh tried to describe the smell of Rosenau and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel Josh is number 761 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Pavel Josh watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Pavel Josh worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Pavel Josh wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

A bullet went through Pavel Josh's sleeve at S-C1 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). Pavel Josh fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Yann Tzukitolotl, now gravely wounded.
Machine-gun fire swept S-C1. Pavel Josh took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Bastian Abdukarimov of the Hegemony (@xojiakbar.abdukarimov1).
No bed for Pavel Josh yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Pavel Josh spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to S-C1.
Pavel carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
joey_yarrito: "You're late," said the corporal when Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Edmund Mvin was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at U-F15 changed before the cheering ended. Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito shouldered another load.
Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at U-F15. Before dawn Norbert Levichapman walked into it, badly wounded.
Two men fed the belt while Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Matthias Lukehomeless was badly wounded.
Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito swept the enemy parapet at U-F15 with one long burst. Dust jumped all along the sandbags. Clement Justindavol was grazed.
Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Across from U-F15, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito saw it. Nils Lucwar was grazed.
Officers came to inspect U-F15. Pavel "Shadow" Yarrito polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Word of Pavel's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
jtall_680: Felix "Tin" Jtall signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-C3 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Felix "Tin" Jtall counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Quentin Khattabka never saw the shovel coming. (@khattabka_) The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Felix "Tin" Jtall helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Jakub "Shadow" Barrett and Felix "Tin" Jtall carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Felix "Tin" Jtall got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 839. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Felix "Tin" Jtall listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Felix "Tin" Jtall held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
A newspaper reached Felix "Tin" Jtall with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Felix "Tin" Jtall. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
A muddy dog crawled into S-C3 through the wire. Felix "Tin" Jtall gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Mercy.
Felix "Tin" Jtall borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
Mercy has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Felix "Tin" Jtall is very proud. Mercy is mainly proud of the biscuits.
Felix sewed a torn coat before sewing a torn man. The man did not mind. He was asleep.
living_with_wild_wolves: Emil Wolves came from Stoneyford, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Emil Wolves folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Emil Wolves was hit hard at Calvary Farm. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin.
Emil Wolves lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

The bearers moved Emil Wolves's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Emil Wolves watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
There was never a bed for Emil Wolves, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F7 on his own feet.
A shell landed close to S-F7. When the dust settled Emil Wolves was still there, holding a lock of hair in a matchbox, laughing without sound.

A sniper's bullet hit Emil Wolves at S-F7. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_). The bearers reached Emil Wolves at S-F7 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_).
Another member of the House of Wolves reached the line: Gideon Wolves. He asked where Emil Wolves had slept, then chose a different corner.
The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Gideon Wolves and two others formed a very irritated windbreak.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Gideon Wolves stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Gideon Wolves borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Albin Chloe was badly wounded. Gideon Wolves got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 139. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon Wolves wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Casimir Sky of the Hegemony and Gideon Wolves of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Hanging Bridge. It is getting crowded.
The whole squad at S-F7 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Gideon Wolves's bullet that found Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn, gravely wounded.
Gideon Wolves fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F7. Gustav Elliott was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.

Gideon Wolves took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-F7, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes of the Hegemony (@mannnylopes). Gideon Wolves was killed outright at S-F7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Anselm "Whistle" Mannnylopes of the Hegemony (@mannnylopes).
The papers connected Pavel Wolves to Gideon Wolves. The men took longer to learn Pavel Wolves's own habits, but they made the effort.

At S-F7 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Pavel Wolves turned around and took a shovel blow. Walter Ice of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Walter Ice of the Hegemony (@iron__from__ice_).

Machine-gun fire swept S-F7. Pavel Wolves took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Dietrich Wolfmananton of the Hegemony (@wolfmanantony). Pavel Wolves was killed at S-F7 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Dietrich Wolfmananton of the Hegemony (@wolfmanantony).
Edmund Wolves joined S-F7 under the shadow of Pavel Wolves's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Edmund was ordered to fire only on a clear target. He waited all day for one. It was the longest day of the week.
mar.stefan16: The new sniper is Quentin Stefan, once a stonemason from Stoneyford. The corporal asked if a stonemason was any use in a trench. Quentin Stefan said he would find out.

A bullet grazed Quentin Stefan's ribs at S-R11. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke of the Hegemony (@broeringluke). The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Quentin Stefan looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The men at S-R11 heard Quentin Stefan call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Jonas Fabian of the Hegemony (@itz_fabian0120). The bearers reached Quentin Stefan at S-R11 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Jonas Fabian of the Hegemony (@itz_fabian0120).

The House of Stefan sent Karel Stefan after Quentin Stefan. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. Karel Stefan got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 827. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Karel Stefan watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Karel Stefan's ear at S-R11 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Jonas "Rabbit" Coletonmarti of the Hegemony (@coletonmartin). Karel Stefan fired once through the steel loophole at S-R11 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Bastian "Owl" Hanka was gravely wounded.
Karel Stefan returned to S-R11 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Karel Stefan got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Karel Stefan was hit in the forearm at S-R11. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939). Karel Stefan saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Teodor Klecka, was badly wounded.

Karel Stefan was found at the bottom of the trench at S-R11, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Benedikt "Crow" Hanka of the Hegemony (@hanka_b97). Karel Stefan was killed on watch at S-R11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Benedikt "Crow" Hanka of the Hegemony (@hanka_b97).
Walter Stefan asked about Karel Stefan on arriving at S-R11. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

A bullet went through Walter Stefan's upper arm at S-R11 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Hume of the Hegemony (@hunnnter_hume).

The wound on Walter's arm opened again at S-R11. The medic said he had lifted too much, too soon. A bed in the field hospital finally opened up. Walter was lifted in, and the first thing he said was thank you.
parker.j.mccauley: On Day 6, Karel Mccauley arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

The relief column arrived early. Karel Mccauley made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A parcel from home held a comb. Karel Mccauley has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Mccauley repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at S-S11 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix "Tin" Singh had Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony in the sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Karel Mccauley was lighting a pipe. Felix "Tin" Singh let the match burn all the way down. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Mccauley had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Pavel "Ghost" Williambecke was grazed. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Karel Mccauley during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Karel Mccauley fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Bastian Szko was badly wounded trying to cross it. Karel Mccauley saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-S11 and fired once. Tobias "Crow" Cowboii was badly wounded. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel Mccauley answered to number 398. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Karel Mccauley helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Karel Mccauley offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Mccauley cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Karel Mccauley carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Marek "Brick" Agiraffedog, grazed. Karel Mccauley cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Mail came up the line with a letter for Karel Mccauley. Karel Mccauley read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Karel Mccauley was faster. Teodor "Mud" Oliverthemag was grazed. Karel Mccauley read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.

The gun crews at S-S11 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Arno Ekwilks was grazed. Karel Mccauley did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Karel Mccauley fired back. Karel "Brick" Jarnvag was grazed. The corporal called out the mail. Karel Mccauley heard the name and almost ran.
Karel had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Silas Caydan was badly wounded.
roman_askey_: Jonas "Owl" Askey unpacked a key to a house that is no longer there at R-F13. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Jonas "Owl" Askey's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.

Jonas "Owl" Askey got a letter from Ilse. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Jonas "Owl" Askey watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The order named Jonas "Owl" Askey as Lance Corporal. He read it twice, then asked who would take over his watch.
New laces made Jonas "Owl" Askey's boots look almost respectable, until he stood up.

Jonas "Owl" Askey wrote back to Ilse and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. The Hegemony won Hill 304. In R-F13, Jonas "Owl" Askey listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
No post for Jonas "Owl" Askey this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.

A bullet clipped Jonas "Owl" Askey's helmet at R-F13 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Tobias Deadeyesimul of the Hegemony (@deadeyesimulacrum). A clear shot from R-F13. Jonas "Owl" Askey grazed Wendel Green and slid back down below the parapet.
Jonas "Owl" Askey was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F13. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).
The medics called Jonas "Owl" Askey 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Jonas "Owl" Askey is back on the line.

Jonas "Owl" Askey fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Severin Summer, now badly wounded. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Jonas "Owl" Askey wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A parcel from Ilse: socks, a cake gone hard as a brick, and a pressed flower. Jonas "Owl" Askey ate the cake and kept the flower in a key to a house that is no longer there's place. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jonas "Owl" Askey wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A bullet went through Jonas "Owl" Askey's sleeve at R-F13 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz). Jonas "Owl" Askey had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Gideon Green was badly wounded.

A bullet hit Jonas "Owl" Askey in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F13. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Marek Elox of the Hegemony (@gm_elox). Jonas "Owl" Askey was hit at R-F13 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Marek Elox of the Hegemony (@gm_elox).
A letter came with Marek Askey: "I am Jonas "Owl" Askey's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Marek Askey traded a key to a house that is no longer there for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Marek Askey held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F13. Marek Askey was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Konrad Jngaf of the Hegemony (@gremlin_jngaf).
Isidor "Owl" Askey had heard about Marek Askey's courage. At R-F13, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A bullet went through Isidor "Owl" Askey's upper arm at R-F13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Bram Wade of the Hegemony (@wade_b_p). Isidor "Owl" Askey was killed at R-F13 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Bram Wade of the Hegemony (@wade_b_p).
The papers connected Jakub Askey to Isidor "Owl" Askey. The men took longer to learn Jakub Askey's own habits, but they made the effort.
Jakub caught Benedikt Noirangelfan writing a love letter and read it over Benedikt shoulder. Benedikt Noirangelfan threw a boot. Jakub told nobody.
straight_dogma_son: Ulrich Son arrived at T-F18 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The new duty roster listed Ulrich Son as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F18 with the rations. Ulrich Son ate while listening to the revised orders. A letter from home reached Ulrich Son before dusk. Ulrich Son read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ulrich Son got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces. A letter from home reached Ulrich Son before dusk. Ulrich Son read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-F18, Ulrich Son listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Ulrich Son received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. A letter from home reached Ulrich Son before dusk. Ulrich Son read it twice and slept a little easier.
Ulrich Son measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.

Wiring party. Ulrich Son held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at T-F18, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Ulrich Son before dusk. Ulrich Son read it twice and slept a little easier.

Ulrich Son and Ulrich Yeti carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. A letter from home reached Ulrich Son before dusk. Ulrich Son read it twice and slept a little easier.

The Hegemony sentry, Oskar Ttenrivers, shouted once. Ulrich Son silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@r0ttenrivers) Ulrich Son came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. A thin letter reached Ulrich Son. Only five lines long, and Ulrich Son knew every one of them by heart before supper.
Ulrich Son spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.

Ulrich tied a splint with a bayonet scabbard and a bootlace. It looked terrible and worked perfectly. Ulrich got a letter from home with a recipe in it. {He} read it out to the cook, who said it could not be done with army flour.
tkendrick47: Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick arrived at R-R4 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick and Silas Mcgrail split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 939. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Someone asked Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.

A bullet hit Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick's belt buckle at R-R4 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Benedikt Snake of the Hegemony (@jake_the_snake6424).
A single shot from across the wire hit Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick in the thigh at R-R4. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Emil "Ghost" Fuck of the Hegemony (@fuck271or6m).
Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Viktor "Mud" Tkendrick came to the front because his older brother Wendel "Whistle" Tkendrick never came home. He carries a bullet that missed him.
Viktor slipped on the duckboards at R-R4 just as a bullet went by. He lost some skin from the fall and none from the bullet. Shot by Zeno Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21).
val_scm18: Nobody saw Pavel "Crow" Scm arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-C14, and a quiet rifleman under it.
Pavel "Crow" Scm walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A new recruit would not eat with the others. Pavel "Crow" Scm left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it. The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel "Crow" Scm is number 945 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Pavel "Crow" Scm wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Pavel "Crow" Scm fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-C14. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Pavel "Crow" Scm won before reaching the end of his entry.

A bullet hit Pavel "Crow" Scm in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-C14. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe of the Concord (@kjwthe1).
There was never a bed for Pavel "Crow" Scm, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-C14 on his own feet.

A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel "Crow" Scm in the thigh at S-C14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Benedikt "Mole" Olliedav of the Concord (@olliedav124). Pavel "Crow" Scm was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding a pocket Bible with a hole in it.

There were too few medics and too many wounded. Pavel "Crow" Scm waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it. Pavel "Crow" Scm was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door.
Pavel ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine.
